name: @usertax-examples/bare-rn-app
description: Example bare React Native app measured by usertax in CI (JavaScript bundles).

scripts.build: pnpm run build:android && pnpm run build:ios
scripts.build:android: react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --minify true --entry-file index.js --bundle-output dist/android/index.android.bundle --sourcemap-output dist/android/index.android.bundle.map --assets-dest dist/android/res
scripts.build:ios: react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --minify true --entry-file index.js --bundle-output dist/ios/main.jsbundle --sourcemap-output dist/ios/main.jsbundle.map --assets-dest dist/ios
